{{Quote|I like to learn from my mistakes. You should try it sometimes.|Rans|<ref name="Power Play">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Power Play|Voss}}</ref>}}
'''Rans''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military during of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Growing up in the quiet years before the resurgent of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in his early career, Rans fought only scattered [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans and was totally unprepared to the total war caused by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. However, his quick-thinking and easy charm helped him to ascend the ranks and and to build up the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] military to new and impressive standards. His looks also made him a media darling and at some point he married the war-veteran [[Galena Rans]]. Rans was totally outplayed by the Sith strategy of the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].<ref name="TOR" />

Learning from this terrible lesson, Rans deployed new plans and all his strength to at last annihilate the Sith. For this, Rans commanded the Republic armies in the [[Battle of Ilum]]. At one point he was captured by the Imperials, but was rescued and finally, thanks to the [[New Empire|division on the Sith side]], Rans won the fight. After the battle, Rans retired, and the position of Supreme Commander was transferred to [[Jace Malcom]].<ref name="TOR" />
